Pirates (nation 10) with 9 cities: "The management of Skull & Crossbones, Inc. regret to inform you that they are unable to add new cities to their portfolio.  %s is spared from Piracy.". room = min(9 - Pirate cities, 4); [0xF7C9C] = v's coastal cities (territory byte +0 bit 0x02). None: "The primary victim %s has no coastal cities for the Pirates to takeover.". Else "%s falls victim to Pirates.", then k = room < 2 ? room : min(count,2): human c -> f2468C(c, v, k, 0); else f3C720(0xF596C), f24EB8(c, v, k), f3C6A0(0xF596C). room == 1 and count > 1 -> "The Pirates are unable to add more cities.  The remaining primary and all secondary victims are spared." and end. Pirates now at 9 -> "...The secondary victims are spared.". Secondary: room2 = min(9 - Pirate cities, 2); count = coastal cities of the other nations (k != v, k != c); none -> "Secondary victims have no coastal cities for the Pirates to takeover."; human v -> f2468C(c, v, k2, 1); else "%s selects secondary coastal cities to be taken by Pirates." (0x79270 2500/-500), f3C720, f3CBBC, f252BC(c, v, k2), f3C6A0. room2 == 1 and count > 1 -> "The Pirates are unable to add more cities.  The remaining secondary victims are spared.". 0x1E69C(i).
0x241d8.globals: reads nation 10 +0x51 (byte 0xF1CE3), nation city lists, territory byte +0 bit 0x02, +0x9A, [0xF0980]; writes [0xF7C9C] (count only), [0xF40F8]
0x241d8.calls: sprintf, 0x79270, f2468C, 0x3C720/0x3C6A0 (unported: set all buttons of a dialog up / down and redraw), f24EB8, f3A924, f3CBBC, f252BC, 0x1E69C
0x241d8.waits_for_input: CONTINUE messages; the human screens in f2468C
0x241d8.risks: The primary branch tests the chooser c for human, the secondary branch tests the victim v. Several messages share the jump to one 0x79270 call with the anim argument pushed on different paths (push 1 / push ecx / push edi). Text slip 'takeover' (verb: 'take over'), twice.

0x2468c.purpose: Human picks cities: f2468C(c chooser, v victim, k to take, mode: 0 Piracy primary, 1 Piracy secondary, 2 Tax Revolt). Backs up the area records (malloc 0x2B65 -> [0xEED74]), tstate (0x1E0 -> [0xEED7C]) and nations 1..11 (0x954 -> [0xEED78]); debug log 0x78B0C("ChooseCitiesToLoseToPirates"). Marks 0xF7AC4[12]: modes 0/2 v, mode 1 every nation in play except v and c. Text: mode 2 "%s, select cities to be received thru Tax Revolt." (c); mode 0 "%s, select %s coastal cities to be taken by Pirates." (c, v's adjective); mode 1 "%s, select secondary coastal cities to be taken by Pirates." (v) in f3AB7C; "LEFT TO"/"REMOVE" labels; dialog 0xBEE78 (arrows, RESTART 0x41 -> -0x63, REMOVE 0x3F -> -0x65, FINISHED). f28CFC(v, mode 2 ? 2 : 0x1E, 0) builds the list. Loop: territory name, number left (itoa) in (0x136,0x181); REMOVE enabled / FINISHED disabled while left > 0, swapped at 0; on redraw f459E4(v), centre or f3D52C(0,0), and in phase 15 0x7A4C4. REMOVE: mode 1 unmarks the owner (one city per secondary victim); 0x78F04(t, owner); mode != 2: 0x78E74(t, 10) (Pirate city), area +0x3B+owner = 2 and every +0x3C+j == 1 becomes 2; mode 2: 0x78E74(t, c), area +0x3B+owner = 1; left--, entry removed, f79A9C clamp, list rebuilt. RESTART (confirmed by 0x795A8 YES/NO when byte [0xF097C]&8): records restored, left = k. FINISHED: f78664(0xBEE78), the three blocks freed and their pointers zeroed.
0x2468c.globals: rw area records, tstate, nations 1..11 (restore), malloc'd [0xEED74]/[0xEED78]/[0xEED7C], bytes 0xF7AC4[12], 0xF7CA0/[0xF7C9C]; reads [0xF097C] bit 0x08 (aciv.cfg: confirm restart, G), byte [0xF4102] (phase)
0x2468c.calls: 0x822B5 (malloc; names.txt 'malloc (0x822B5)?', its body reads only eax), 0x78B0C (debug no-op), f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, fg_vbopen, f3AF8C, fg_setcolor, f3A3A0, f3A044, fg_vbclose, sprintf, f3AB7C, f7876C, f7853C, f3B05C, f28CFC, f3C9D0, f3A0B0, itoa, f3F670, f3F624, f3C3D0, f3C314, f459E4, f3DA60, f3D52C, f3CBBC, 0x7A4C4, f78BA4, 0x78F04, 0x78E74, 0x795A8 (unported YES/NO box), f79A9C, f78664, free
0x2468c.risks: Mode 1: if every remaining candidate belongs to the one secondary victim already used, the list is empty while left > 0: FINISHED stays disabled and REMOVE acts on 0xF7CA0[0] = -1 (writes before tstate) (G scenario from D code). No NULL check on malloc. Heap blocks held in data fields (0xEED74..) that in-game RESTORE/NEW GAME free. Static dialog 0xBEE78.

0x24eb8.purpose: AI takes the victim's coastal cities: f24EB8(c, v, k). 0xF7AC4 cleared, [v] = 1, f28CFC(v, 0x1E, 0); local list of v's entries (m). take = min(m, 2). m 1..2: first city -> 0x78F04(t,v), 0x78E74(t,10), area +0x3B+v = 2, +0x3C+j 1 -> 2, "%s is overrun by the Pirates." (territory) via 0x79270(2500 or -500 by [0xF0980]&4, v, t, text, 1); if the list has exactly 2: the second (0xF7CA4) likewise. m > 2: twice t = 0x2E1D0(v, 0x1E) (unported AI pick), 0x78F04(t,v), its local index found, 0x78E74(t,10), marks, message.
0x24eb8.globals: writes 0xF7AC4, 0xF7CA0/[0xF7C9C] (via f28CFC), tstate, city lists, area marks; reads [0xF0980]
0x24eb8.waits_for_input: 0x79270 timed 2.5 s or CONTINUE by option
0x24eb8.risks: BUG(1995), D: the count k from the caller (room for Pirate cities) is never read; the AI always takes min(cities, 2), so with one Pirate slot left the Pirates get a 10th city (list byte +0x5B) and the next Piracy computes room = -1 (G for the consequences). The local index of 0x2E1D0's pick is uninitialised if not found.

0x252bc.purpose: AI picks secondary victims: f252BC(c, v, k). Nations k' in play with cities, k' != v, k' != c, sorted descending by int32 0xF52E0[10v + k']. For each in that order while k > 0: t = f25548(k'); t >= 0: owner = tstate owner, 0x78F04(t,k'), 0x78E74(t,10), area +0x3B+owner = 2, +0x3C+j 1 -> 2, "Pirates overrun %s as a secondary victim." via 0x79270(2500 or -500, v, t, text, 1), k--.
0x252bc.globals: reads 0xF52E0, nation +0x9A/+0x51, [0xF0980]; writes tstate, lists, area marks
0x252bc.risks: 10-entry stack list; bubble sort on int32 scores.

0x25548.purpose: Coastal city of nation n for the Pirates: records {t, sum} (stack, 8 bytes) for n's coastal cities built this round (tstate +1 == int16 [0xF40FC]), sum = n's tokens in the land neighbours; if any: sort ascending by pop limit, then ascending by sum (stable); return record 0's t. Else the same over the coastal cities not built this round. None: -1.
0x25548.globals: reads n's city list, territory byte +0 bit 0x02 and +1 bits 3..5, tstate +1 (round built), int16 [0xF40FC] (round), adjacency 0xF8E7C, area tokens
0x25548.risks: Unsigned byte compares (jbe) of the limits; 1.3 KB stack frame.

0x25a38.purpose: Famine for record i: message area (0xA9,0x154,0x12C,0x15); n = victim, [0xF40F8] = n. Loss = min(5*cities + board tokens +0x98, 10) into byte 0xF547C[n]; with Pottery (+0x24) and Grain cards (byte +0x08) the Grain step: human f27CEC(n), AI f27850(n). Loss <= 0: "Your usage of Grain has prevented Famine in %s.". Human (not PBEM): "Famine ravages %s." (CONTINUE), then f27FCC(n, loss, "%s, choose sites of Famine losses.", 0x15, 0, 0); AI: "Famine ravages %s.", f3A990, f3CBBC, f260C4(n, loss, 0x15, -1). Secondary: int16 0xF796C[k] = min(5*cities + tokens, 8) for the others; total <= 20: copied to 0xF547C[k] and 0x291D0(n,-1,"Assignments for Famine secondary losses"); else human "%s, assign secondary losses for Famine." + 0x29550(n,-1,20,text), AI f27518(n,-1,20,0x15). Then k 1..9 with 0xF547C[k] != 0: Pottery+Grain -> human f27CEC, AI f27850 + f78A20(2000); loss > 0: human f27FCC(k, loss, "Famine also ravages %s.\nChoose sites of losses.", 0x15, 0, 0), AI f260C4(k, loss, 0x15, -1). 0x1E69C(i); [0xBB400] = 0x23.
0x25a38.globals: rw bytes 0xF547C[1..9], int16 0xF796C[1..9], message area 0xBB3FA..; reads nation +0x08, +0x24, +0x51, +0x98, +0x9A
0x25a38.risks: The secondary loop runs over k = 1..9 including the primary victim n; it relies on 0xF547C[n] having been overwritten (0 by the copy path; G for 0x29550/f27518 paths). Bytes 0xF547C read as dword sar 24. Message area height changed and restored to 0x23.

0x260c4.category: calamity AI: unit losses (Famine, Epidemic, Flood)
0x260c4.purpose: AI loses L unit points: f260C4(n, L, kind 0x15 Famine / 0x1B Epidemic / 0x19 Flood, flood plain S or -1). f28CFC(n, kind, S); "%s ravages %s.\nChoosing sites of losses." via 0x79270(1500). era = int16 AST table 0xBCFDA[n][+0x5C]. Cities to reduce R: Famine L == 10: 1 if (era<=1, cities>=3) (2,>=4) (3,>=5) (>=4,>=6), else (tokens - 10 < 2*cities); Epidemic L >= 10: 2 by the same pattern with one more city, else 1 if tokens-16 < 2*cities; secondary: 1 if tokens - territories(+0x60) < L and cities > 0. per = 5 Famine, 4 Epidemic, 1 else; R raised until tokens - territories + R*per >= L, capped at cities. Each city (not Flood): t = f213C0(n)-1, "%s forces %s to eliminate %s." (-550, wait 500), 0x78FEC reduce, L -= 5 - tokens there, then tokens removed (Epidemic keeps 1) while L > 0, message again (2000, or 500/1500 unattended, or -500 by [0xF0980]&4), t removed from the list. Flood: n's cities on plain S with territory byte +1 bit 0x80 eliminated (L -= 5) while L >= 1, then every token on the plain territories. Famine tokens: if dword 0xF4204[n] == 0, three passes (limit > 2: take limit-2 or all of L; limit 2: the excess; then 1 each) repeated until L == 0; else list sorted ascending by 0xEED84[160n+t] and 1 token at a time. Epidemic tokens: flag 0 over n's own territory list +0x61.. (keep 1), else by priority. Plans (int16 T[160], A[160] on the stack) merged per territory, then applied: "%s forces %s to reduce\npopulation by %d in %s." (-550, wait 500), f57CE8, board -= A, stock += A, message again.
0x260c4.globals: reads 0xF7CA0/[0xF7C9C], AST table 0xBCFDA, flood-plain table 0xBEE0A (22-byte records {int16 count, char *name (RHONE, PO, DANUBE, TIGRUS-EUPHRATES, NILE), int16 t[8]}), 0xEED84, dword 0xF4204[n], nation +0x51, +0x5C, +0x60/+0x61.., +0x98, [0xF0980], int16 [0xF40BA]; writes tokens, cities, +0x98/+0x99, the list
0x260c4.calls: f28CFC, sprintf, 0x79270, f213C0, f78A20, 0x78FEC, f57CE8, f3F670, f3F624, f3DA60, 0x78F04, f7BA64
0x260c4.waits_for_input: messages timed (2000 ms, or 500/1500 ms unattended) or CONTINUE when byte [0xF0980]&4
0x260c4.risks: BUG(1995), D: the Flood capacity reads int16 [0xBEE08 + 22S], two bytes before the plain's count (the previous record's last slot, 0), so the city loop stops only on L. R is uninitialised for Flood (not used further). The calamity name buffer is uninitialised for other kinds. The list compaction moves a -1 hole only past entries > 0 (territory 0 blocks it). Token passes do not decrement their local counts and repeat until L == 0: they can plan more than exists, and with no tokens left they loop forever (G). Long switch chains; int16 stack arrays [160].

0x27518.purpose: Primary victim n (AI) assigns `total` secondary losses: f27518(n, trader, total, kind). Records {k, score} for k 0..9: not in play -99999, else int32 0xF52E0[10n+k] + 100*int8 [0x109E23 + 9(n-1) + k] (G: a per-pair history); bubble sort descending. List of nations with cnt[k] (int16 0xF796C) > 0 in that order. memset(0xF547C, 0, 14); first gets cnt; second min(cnt, share) with share = (total+1)/2 when more than 2 nations, else total; third min(cnt, share, rest); the rest min(cnt, rest). "Assignments for %s secondary losses" (calamity name 0xC76E0[kind]) -> 0x291D0(n, trader, text).
0x27518.globals: writes bytes 0xF547C[0..13]; reads int16 0xF796C, 0xF52E0, bytes 0x109E23.., nation +0x9A
0x27518.risks: Nation 0 and n itself take part in the sort. The first nation gets its full cnt without clamping to total; nations 2 and 3 are read from the stack list even when fewer exist (safe only because callers pass total < sum of cnt). The loop for the 4th+ nations subtracts cnt instead of the amount given (same outcome).

0x27850.purpose: AI decides Grain use against Famine for n: background 3; "GRAIN"/"USED"/"LOSSES"/"REDUCED TO" labels; "%s - choosing Grain reduction in Famine losses."; int16 used = 0xF409A[n] = 0; f459E4, f3D9FC(n); boxes with used and max(0xF547C[n], 0); wait 1000. g = Grain cards (+0x08). g <= 2: hand value v = sum c_i^2*((i+1)>>1); if v < 60, or v - 4*(byte +0x2C)^2 >= 60: use (L = min(loss,8); 4g > loss: used += L/5+1, loss -= 4*(L/5)+4; else used += g, loss -= 4g). g > 2: one card if tokens < 2*cities + 4 (used++, loss -= 4), else used = 0. Boxes redrawn, wait 2500.
0x27850.calls: f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, fg_vbopen, fg_setcolor, f3A3A0, f3A044, fg_vbclose, f7876C, sprintf, f3A9F4, f3B05C, f459E4, f3F670, f3D9FC, f3C9D0, itoa, f3A0B0, f3CBBC, f78A20
0x27850.risks: BUG(1995), D read / G intent: the 'hand without Grain' test subtracts 4*(byte +0x2C)^2, +0x2C being the Coinage advance, where the Grain count +0x08 (24 bytes earlier) is meant. The Grain cards are not removed here (only the counter 0xF409A).

0x27cec.purpose: Human chooses how many Grain cards to use: dialog 0xBF264 (arrows at (296,385)/(330,385), FINISHED) appended; background 3, arrow sprites, the four labels, "%s - choose Grain reduction of Famine losses."; used 0xF409A[n] = 0; f459E4, f3D9FC. Loop: boxes with used and max(loss,0); f78BA4(0xF596C, 0): left (-9) used-- and loss += 4 if used > 0; right (-10) used++ and loss -= 4 if loss > 0 and used < Grain cards (+0x08); FINISHED ends. f78664(0xBF264).
0x27cec.calls: f7853C, f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, fg_vbopen, f3AF8C, fg_setcolor, f3A3A0, f3A044, fg_vbclose, f7876C, sprintf, f3A9F4, f3B05C, f459E4, f3F670, f3D9FC, f3C9D0, itoa, f3A0B0, f3CBBC, f78BA4, f78664
0x27cec.waits_for_input: yes: f78BA4(0xF596C, 0) (no map clicks) until FINISHED
0x27cec.risks: Losses may go negative (shown as 0, clamped by the caller).

0x27fcc.purpose: Human removes units: f27FCC(n, L, text, kind, [stack] sub, [stack] target T); ret 8. Backups as f2468C (area, tstate, nations 1..13: 0xAE2 bytes); debug log "NationLosesUnits". Background 3, arrows at (0xFB,0x186)/(0x178,0x186), "LEFT TO"/"REMOVE" at y 0x176, f3AB7C(text), f7876C. Dialog 0xBF650 (REMOVE ONE 0x3F -> -0x65, REMOVE ALL 0x40 -> -0x66, REDUCE CITY 0x3E -> -0xE, RESTART 0x41, FINISHED): for kinds 7, 8, 9 the two REMOVE buttons move to x 0xDB/0x13F and REDUCE CITY is styled 2 and disabled, otherwise x 0xA9/0x10D, style 1, enabled. f28CFC(n, kind, sub); T != 0: "TARGET" box. Loop: FINISHED only when left == T; REMOVE ONE/ALL enabled while FINISHED is off and left > 0 (Epidemic: only on a city or > 1 token); REDUCE CITY on a city; left < T disables everything but RESTART. REMOVE ONE: city -> eliminated (0x78F04, left -= 5), Epidemic reduces (0x78FEC, left -= 5 - (limit + Agriculture), tokens to 1); else one token (Epidemic keeps 1). REMOVE ALL: city reduced then its tokens; else all tokens (Epidemic keeps 1). REDUCE CITY: 0x78FEC, left -= 5 - (limit + Agriculture +0x27). Emptied territories leave the list. RESTART (0x795A8 confirm if [0xF097C]&8) restores. FINISHED: dialog removed, blocks freed, pointers zeroed.
0x27fcc.globals: rw area records, tstate, nations 1..13, [0xEED74]/[0xEED78]/[0xEED7C], 0xF7CA0/[0xF7C9C], dialog 0xBF650 positions/styles (static data); reads [0xF097C]
0x27fcc.calls: 0x822B5 (malloc), 0x78B0C, f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, fg_vbopen, f3AF8C, fg_setcolor, f3A3A0, f3A044, fg_vbclose, f3AB7C, f7876C, f3BB48, f3C0D8, f3BFBC, f7853C, f3B05C, f28CFC, f3C9D0, itoa, f3A0B0, f3F670, f3F624, f3C3D0, f3C314, f3BF30, f459E4, f3DA60, f3D52C, f3CBBC, 0x7A4C4, f78BA4, 0x78F04, 0x78FEC, f57CE8, 0x795A8, f79A9C, f78664, free
0x27fcc.waits_for_input: yes: f78BA4(0xF596C, 1) until FINISHED (only enabled at left == target)
0x27fcc.risks: Two stack arguments (ret 8) after four register ones. REDUCE subtracts 5 - (limit + Agriculture) although 0x78FEC adds Agriculture only when no other nation is there; left can grow, and the 'left != 0' loops then remove every token (G). Static dialog edited per call. No NULL check on malloc. Large switch on negative codes with unsigned compares.

0x28cfc.purpose: Builds the choice list 0xF7CA0 (157 entries -1 first) and [0xF7C9C] for nation n by kind: 0x15, 4, 9: n's cities or tokens; 0x1B: n's cities or > 1 token; 7: byte 0xF7984[t] != 0; 8: byte 0xF7A24[t] != 0; 6: n's tokens; 3: movable tokens (area +0x24+n); 2, 5: n's cities; 0x1E: cities of the nations marked in 0xF7AC4 on coastal territories (byte +0 bit 0x02); 0x19: for the plain S (third argument) of table 0xBEE0A, n's cities with territory byte +1 bit 0x80, or n's tokens; other kinds: empty.
0x28cfc.globals: writes 0xF7CA0[157], [0xF7C9C]; reads tstate, area +0x0E+n/+0x24+n, 0xF7984, 0xF7A24, 0xF7AC4, 0xBEE0A, territory bytes
0x28cfc.risks: Chain of compares on the kind (no jump table). The plain record is addressed as 11*S words from 0xBEE08 with sar 16 reads; keep exactly. Territories 157..159 never listed.

0x291d0.purpose: Summary screen of the secondary losses assigned to other nations (no choice). f291D0(a = eax, b = edx, text = ebx). Loads background 3 into the back buffer ([0xEE168] = 3, fg_vbcopy whole screen from [0xF52CC]). Counts nations n 1..9 with +0x9A != 0, n != a, n != b and int16 0xF796C[n] != 0; returns at once if none. Column width w = (count == 2 ? 200 : 300) / count, first x0 = count == 2 ? 0xDC : 0xAA. f3A924 (restore message area), f3A9F4(text) (left-aligned message), f7876C (phase label). In the back buffer: strip (0xAA..0x1D5, 0x17C..0x1A2) restored from the background, colour 5; for each listed nation j: its name centred at (x0 + w*j, 0x16D, w) (long name 0xC768C[n], or the short name 0xC7664[n] when fgf_width(long) >= w), token sprite 0xF489C + 8n (18x18) centred at y 0x17C, a sunken box (x0+w*j+(w-16)/2, 0x198, 16, 14) and the number int8 0xF547C[n] centred at y 0x19A (itoa into a stack buffer). Then CONTINUE (id 0x2A of dialog 0xBB800) moved to (0x109, 0x1AE), appended to the panel dialog 0xF596C (f7853C), panel drawn (f3B05C(0xF596C,0)), f3D52C(0,0), f3CBBC. Waits until code -1, then removes 0xBB800 (f78664).
0x291d0.globals: reads nation +0x9A (0xF1566 + 199n); int16 0xF796C[n] (units of n subject to secondary losses); int8 0xF547C[n] (losses assigned to n; dword [0xF5479+n] sar 24); names 0xC768C / short names 0xC7664 (only 10 entries, n 1..9 used); sprites 0xF489C + 8n (w at +4 = 0xF48A0+8n); writes byte [0xEE168] = 3; [0xF52C8] back buffer, [0xF52CC] background; dialog 0xBB800 (CONTINUE id 0x2A) x/y rewritten in data; int16 [0xF40BA] (demo/continuous test)
0x291d0.calls: f3CD6C(3), fg_vbcopy, f3A924, f3A9F4, f7876C, fg_vbopen/fg_vbclose, fg_setcolor, fgf_width, f3A0B0, f3AF8C, f3C9D0, itoa, f3BB48, f3BC64, f7853C, f3B05C, f3D52C, f3CBBC, f7BA64, f78BA4, f78A20, f78664
0x291d0.callers: 0x23ACC (Iconoclasm and Heresy, 0x23FAE, 0x24047), 0x25A38 (Famine, 0x25CF8, 0x25F5D), 0x27518 (AI assignment of secondary losses, 0x27844), 0x2E59C (Epidemic, 0x2E839, 0x2E9DF)
0x291d0.waits_for_input: Loop: if f7BA64() == 0, r = f78BA4(0xF596C, 0) (generic click wait, map clicks off); else (unattended demo/test) f78A20(int16 [0xF40BA] == 0 ? 250 : 1000) and r = -1; until r == -1 (CONTINUE).
0x291d0.risks: Stack buffer for itoa and the local nation list (9 ints) indexed by column. Nation list and 0xF796C test duplicated in two loops (must stay identical). The short-name table 0xC7664 has only 10 entries (it runs into 0xC768C): fine for n 1..9. Button records of 0xBB800 are modified in the data object (x, y persist).

0x29550.purpose: The human victim assigns secondary losses to the other nations (+/- per nation). f29550(a = eax victim, b = edx excluded nation (the calamity record's middle byte) or -1, total = ebx, text = ecx). Same layout as 0x291D0 (background 3, columns w/x0 by the count of nations n != a, b with +0x9A != 0 and int16 0xF796C[n] != 0). memset(0xF547C, 0, 14) (0x7D5D0). Panel dialog count reset: int16 [0xF596C] = int16 [0xF5944] (drops appended records). For column j it appends two 20-byte button records copied from templates 0xC0614 (id 0xD3 + j, the minus, at x-8) and 0xC0600 (id 0xCC + j, the plus, at x+0x12), y 0x19A, enabled 1, and draws arrow sprites 0xF51BC / 0xF51C4 at those places. left = min(sum of int16 0xF796C[1..9], total). 'LEFT TO' right-aligned at (0xE8, 0x1B2), 'ASSIGN' at (0x107, 0x1B2). Appends CONTINUE dialog 0xBFA3C (id 0x2A at 319,430), draws the panel, f3D52C(0,0). Loop: f29C94 redraw; hand-made hit test over all records of 0xF596C with enabled == 1 (x <= mx < x+w, y <= my < y+h), f3C5D4 feedback, r = f3FB94(id). r -0x67..-0x6D (ids 0xCC..0xD2, plus for column -0x67-r): if left > 0 and int8 0xF547C[n] < int16 0xF796C[n]: 0xF547C[n]++, left--. r -0x6E..-0x74 (ids 0xD3..0xD9, minus): if 0xF547C[n] > 0: --, left++. After +/-: f29C94, 150 ms, click flag [0xE1630] = 0 and poll again without waiting for release (auto-repeat while held). r == -1 (CONTINUE): int16 [0xF596C] = [0xF5944] and return. Other r: redraw and wait.

Ids 0xCC+j / 0xD3+j allow 7 columns; local list of 9 ints. The dispatcher maps those ids to -0x67.. / -0x6E.. (dispatch.c constants). CONTINUE availability is decided in 0x29C94 (only enabled when left == 0). Byte arithmetic on 0xF547C (signed compares via dword sar 24).

0x29c94.purpose: Redraws the numbers of the assignment screen of 0x29550. f29C94(a = eax, b = edx, list = ebx (caller's stack array of nations), w = ecx, [left], [x0]) (ret 8). In the back buffer: sunken box (0xEF, 0x1AE, 0x12, 0x11) with 'left' centred at (0xEF, 0x1B1, w 0x12); for each listed nation j (same filter as 0x29550): box (x0+w*j+(w-16)/2, 0x198, 16, 14) and int8 0xF547C[list[j]] centred at (x0+w*j, 0x19A, w). Then, if not PBEM (0xE1624 & 0x80 == 0) and a is human (+0x9A == 3): CONTINUE 0x2A of 0xF596C disabled (f3C3D0) while left > 0, else enabled (f3C314); f3CBBC.

0x29e34.purpose: Resolves Civil War for calamity record i (eax). Victim n = byte 0xF77E6+3i, [0xF40F8] = n. Ranks nations in play by units in stock = (9 - cities +0x51)*5 + tokens in stock +0x99 (pairs int16 nation/key in a local array, bubble sort descending over [0xF40EC] entries, ties keep lower nation first); beneficiary B = first. If B == n: '%s has the most units in stock so there is no Civil War.' and end. Faction sizes: Philosophy (+0x36) -> f1 = 0, f2 = 15; else f1 = 15 (+5 Music +0x30, +5 Drama & Poetry +0x2F, +10 Democracy +0x34), f2 = 20. If f1+f2 >= 5*cities + tokens on board (+0x98): 'There are no units available for a second faction, so %s quells Civil War with no losses.', 0x1E69C(i), return. Else 'Civil War breaks out in %s.'. f1 > 0: human victim (not PBEM, +0x9A == 3): '%s, you are the victim of Civil War. Choose units for the first faction.' -> 0x2B6EC(n, f1, text, n, target 12, mode 4); else '... Choosing units for the first faction.' -> 0x2C190(n, f1, text, n, 12, 4, 0). f2 > 0 (chosen by B, still into faction 12): human B: '%s, as beneficiary of the Civil War, choose units for the first faction.' (f1 > 0) or '%s, you are the victim of Civil War but %s will choose units for the first faction.' -> 0x2B6EC; computer: '%s is a beneficiary...' / '%s is the victim of Civil War but %s is choosing...' -> 0x2C190(..., 1). Then every remaining city of n becomes nation 13's (0x78F04, 0x78E74) and all n's tokens move one by one to nation 13 (f57CE8/f57E28, +0x98/+0x99 of both adjusted). If n has Military (+0x35): 0x2AD50(n, B). If nation 13 has no tokens and no cities: 'The Second Faction no longer exists due to Military losses.  %s will take control of the First Faction', chosen = 12, no annexation. Else chosen = human ? 0x2D3E0(n) : 0x2C778(n) with '%s chooses to play the %s Faction.' ('First'/'Second'; shown 2500 ms, or -500 with the 'Calamity AI Pause' toggle 0xF0980 & 4). All units of the chosen faction return to n. Then (choice made) n +0x9B = 1 and the other faction o (12 or 13) goes to B: if B can absorb all ((9-B.cities)*5 + B.stock >= 5*o.cities + o.tokens, 9-B.cities >= o.cities, B.stock >= o.tokens): everything to B, area +0x3B+n = 1 on those areas, '%s annexes the %s faction.'. Else for k over the ranking while o has units (skipping n): cities (all if room, '%s annexes %s faction cities.'; else human 0x2B6EC(n, 9-B.cities, '...Choose cities to annex.', o, B, 5), computer '... cannot fully absorb the Second Faction cities.  Choosing cities to annex.' + 0x2D10C), tokens (all if B.stock suffices, '%s annexes %s faction tokens.'; else human 0x2B6EC(..., B.stock, ..., o, B, 6) or computer message + 0x2D1C0). Whatever o keeps at the end is destroyed (cities removed, tokens back to o's stock). Finally 0x1E69C(i).
0x29e34.globals: calamity list 0xF77E4 + 3i {card, byte +1 (G: nation exempt from secondary effects, the trader), victim}; [0xF40F8] current nation; [0xF40EC] number of players; nation records 0xF14CC+199n: +0x2F +0x30 +0x34 +0x35 +0x36 advances, +0x51 cities, +0x98 tokens on board, +0x99 stock, +0x9A, +0x9B (written 1); faction nations 12 (FIRST FACTION, 0xF1E20) and 13 (SECOND FACTION, 0xF1EE7: +0x51 at 0xF1F38, +0x98 0xF1F7F, +0x99 0xF1F80); city state 0xE2C18 + 3t (+0 owner, +2 bit 0 city); area records 0xE31B8 + 69(t+1): +0x0E+n tokens, +0x3B+n flag written 1; flags 0xE1624 & 0x80 (PBEM); toggles byte 0xF0980 bit 0x04

0x29e34.callers: 0x1E0A0 (calamity resolution loop, jump table 0x1E070 case 0x17, at 0x1E2B3)

0x29e34.risks: Long chain of nested branches with 18 sprintf into a 0x108-byte stack buffer passed to callees. Bubble sort bound is [0xF40EC]-2, not the count of collected nations (identical in a normal game, G). Faction nations 12/13 are real nation records whose +0x98/+0x99 are adjusted token by token; any stale value from a previous Civil War or from 0x2C894 (which does not adjust them) changes the 'no longer exists' and absorb tests. Message for computers says 'Second Faction' even when the faction being annexed is the first. Messages via the unported 0x79270 (5 arguments, one on the stack).

0x2ac94.purpose: Target remainder for removing x unit points from nation n (cities count 5): f2AC94(n = eax, x = edx). q = x/5, r = x%5, c = int8 cities +0x51. If r == 0 and q <= c: 0 (exact with cities). Else m = min(c, q); if x - 5m <= tokens on board +0x98: 0 (exact with cities + tokens); else x - 5(m+1) (negative: the overshoot allowed by breaking one more city). Callers remove units while left > this value.
0x2ac94.risks: Signed idiv; returns a negative value by design. Leaf with unusual prologue order (push 0x2C; __CHK before the frame).

0x2ad50.purpose: Military losses after a Civil War (victim has Military). f2AD50(victim = eax, beneficiary = edx). memset 0xF7984[157] and 0xF7A24[157]. 0xF7A24: areas of the second faction (13) adjacent (land list [0xF8E7C+4t], second list [0xF90FC+4t]) to an area of the first faction (12); 0xF7984: first-faction areas adjacent to the second. A1 / A2 = units there (city 5, else tokens). Each faction loses 5 points: if 0 < A1 <= 5, all adjacent first-faction units are removed automatically on screen 3 ('LEFT TO' / 'REMOVE', 'Removing First Faction units adjacent to Second Faction for Military losses.', dialog [0xF8E78] disabled, 0x2EE6C after each area, 1.5 s each), adjusting nation 12's +0x98/+0x99. Rest r1: mode = A1 <= 5 ? 9 : 7, ov = 0x2AC94(12, r1), flag = 0x2C778(victim) != 12; if r1 > 0: human victim -> '%s, choose MILITARY losses for First Faction.' NationLosesUnits 0x27FCC(12, r1, text, mode, [0, ov]); computer -> '%s choosing MILITARY losses for First Faction.' 0x2C894(12, r1, text, ov, [flag, mode]). Same for the second faction (13) with 0xF7A24 and modes 9/8, chosen by the beneficiary ('%s, choose MILITARY losses for Second Faction.' / '%s choosing ...'), only if nation 13 still has tokens or cities, AI flag inverted.
0x2ad50.globals: writes byte arrays 0xF7984[157], 0xF7A24[157]; adjacency pointers [0xF8E7C+4t] and [0xF90FC+4t] (int16 count, int16 territories); city state 0xE2C18; area +0x1A / +0x1B (tokens of 12 / 13); nation 12 +0x98 0xF1EB8, +0x99 0xF1EB9; nation 13 0xF1F7F/0xF1F80, cities 0xF1F38; dialog [0xF8E78]; byte [0xEE168] = 3
0x2ad50.calls: memset 0x7D5D0, f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, fg_vbopen/vbclose, fg_setcolor, f3A3A0, f3A044, f3AB7C, f7876C, f3B05C, f3C940, 0x2EE6C, f57CE8, 0x78F04, f3C8C4, 0x2AC94, 0x2C778, sprintf, 0x27FCC NationLosesUnits, 0x2C894
0x2ad50.waits_for_input: Human losses through NationLosesUnits (unported click screen); automatic removals pause 1500 ms per area in 0x2EE6C.
0x2ad50.risks: Two marker arrays are reused as working sets and cleared bit by bit. The AI's 0x2C894 is called for faction nations 12/13 and indexes 10-nation tables with them (see 0x2C894). Modes 7/8/9 of NationLosesUnits are defined there (not here). ebp-0xa8 text buffer passed by pointer.

0x2b6ec.category: calamity UI (human chooses units: faction / annex)
0x2b6ec.purpose: Human selection of units to move from nation src to nation target, the screen behind Civil War's faction choice and annexations (it passes 'ChooseFirstFaction' to the debug stub f78B0C). f2B6EC(x = eax (nation shown in the panel, marker owner), count = edx, text = ebx, src = ecx, [target], [mode]) (ret 8). Message height int16 [0xBB400] = 0x15. Backs up the areas (malloc 0x2B65 -> [0xEED74]), the city state 0xE2C18 (0x1E0 -> [0xEED7C]) and nations 1..13 (0xAE2 -> [0xEED78]). Screen 3, arrow sprites 0xF51AC (0xFB,0x186) / 0xF51B4 (0x178,0x186), 'LEFT TO' at 0x12F. Mode 4: 'SELECT', buttons 0x3F 'SELECT ONE' (x 0xDB) / 0x40 'SELECT ALL', a city counts 5; mode 5: 'ANNEX', 0x3F 'ANNEX' at x 0x10E, 0x40 disabled with style 2 (invisible), a city counts 1; mode 6: 'ANNEX', 'ANNEX ONE' / 'ANNEX ALL', 1 per city. Dialog 0xBFE28 appended (arrows 0x39/0x3A, 0x3F, 0x40, RESTART 0x41, FINISHED 0x2A). Candidate list 0xF7CA0/0xF7C9C from 0x28CFC(src, mode, 0). Loop: name box (0x109,0x186,0x6E,0x13) with the candidate's territory name 0xC77D8[t], count box (0x136,0x172) with 'left', f459E4(x), highlight t (f3F624 15); FINISHED enabled only when left == 0 (else 0x3F/0x40 enabled); if left < 0 all three disabled; recentre (f3DA60 or f3D52C(0,0)); r = f78BA4(0xF596C, 1). r >= 0: idx = r. -9/-10: idx -/+. -0x65 ONE: a city at t: mode != 4 -> area +0x3B+x = 1; 0x78F04(t, src), 0x78E74(t, target), left -= 5 or 1; a token: left--, f57CE8(t, src, 0, 1), src +0x98-- +0x99++, f57E28(t, target, 1), target +0x98++ +0x99--. -0x66 ALL: city as ONE; tokens while left != 0 and src has tokens there. Entry removed when emptied (shift, count--, f79A9C clamp). -0x63 RESTART: 'Are you sure you want to Restart?' asked with 0x795A8 only if toggle 0xF097C & 8 (Restart Confirmations; proceeds on -0x61); restores the three backups, left = count, list rebuilt. -1 FINISHED: removes 0xBFE28, frees the backups and zeroes [0xEED74]/[0xEED7C]/[0xEED78].
0x2b6ec.globals: heap fields [0xEED74], [0xEED78], [0xEED7C] (also freed by NEW GAME/RESTORE); areas 0xE31B8 (whole, 161x69), 0xE2C18 (160x3), nations 1..13; candidate list int32 0xF7CA0[], count [0xF7C9C]; int16 [0xBB400] = 0x15; dialog 0xBFE28 (labels, x, enabled, style rewritten in data); names 0xC77D8; toggles 0xF097C
0x2b6ec.calls: malloc 0x822B5 (3), f78B0C (debug stub), f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, fg_vbopen/vbclose, f3AF8C, fg_setcolor, f3A3A0, f3A044, f3C9D0, itoa, f3A0B0, f3C284, f3BB48, f3BFBC, f3C0D8, f3AB7C, f7876C, f7853C, f3B05C, 0x28CFC, f459E4, f3F670, f3F624, f3C3D0, f3C314, f3DA60, f3D52C, f3CBBC, f78BA4, 0x78F04, 0x78E74, f57CE8, f57E28, sprintf, 0x795A8 (confirm box), f79A9C, f78664, free
0x2b6ec.waits_for_input: f78BA4(0xF596C, 1) loop (map clicks select a candidate: r >= 0); optional confirm box 0x795A8 for RESTART.
0x2b6ec.risks: BUG(1995) candidate (D): the ALL path moves tokens with target +0x99 decremented and then incremented again (0x2BF48 dec, 0x2BF55 inc), so the target's stock is not reduced, unlike ONE; with mode 6 the beneficiary gains tokens from nothing. Mode 4 can take a city (5) with fewer than 5 left: left < 0 disables 0x3F, 0x40 and FINISHED, leaving only the arrows and RESTART (G: soft lock unless RESTART). The 'TARGET' box (local ebp-0x10, always 0) is dead code. Mode 5 makes 0x40 invisible (style 2) but the loop's f3C314 enables it, so an invisible ALL area is clickable (same effect as ANNEX for cities). Heap blocks held in globals; a longjmp out (RESTORE/NEW GAME from the panel) leaves them to the dispatcher's frees. Dialog records edited in the data object persist to the next call.

0x2c190.purpose: Computer counterpart of 0x2B6EC for the Civil War faction choice. f2C190(x = eax, count = edx, text = ebx, src = ecx, [target], [mode], [flag]) (ret 0xC). int16 [0xBB400] = 0x15; screen 3 into the back buffer; 'LEFT TO' at (0x12F,0x176) and 'SELECT' (mode 4) or 'ANNEX' (5, 6) at (0x150,0x176); f3AB7C(text), f7876C; candidates 0x28CFC(src, mode, 0); then 0x2C298(x, count, src, target, (int8)flag).

0x2c190.risks: Three stack arguments, callee pops 0xC; flag passed on sign-extended from a byte.

0x2c298.category: calamity AI (choose units for a faction)
0x2c298.purpose: The computer picks count unit points of src for faction target from the candidate list. f2C298(x = eax, count = edx, src = ebx, target = ecx, [flag]) (ret 4). Disables dialog [0xF8E78]; 0x2EE6C(x, -1, left) shows the count. Patches Iberia's AI tables in the data object by player count: [0xF40F0] > 3 -> 0xC0638..0xC0644 = 149,151,143,144 and 0xC06CC..0xC06DC = 150,135,131,142,141; else 33,127,53,36 and 19,34,52,18,7. keep = (count >= 20 and flag == 0). T = sum of x's tokens over the candidates; citiesNeeded = ceil((count - min(T,10)) / 5). Pass over candidates with a city while taken < citiesNeeded and left >= 5: with keep, only cities listed in 0xC0618[x][0..3]; without keep, any; a city moves (0x78F04 src, 0x78E74 target), left -= 5, taken++ (4th city sets taken = 9: at most 4), removed from the list, 0x2EE6C(x, t, left); if the first pass ends short, a second pass without the table starts at index 1. Then two passes for tokens over the list (first restricted by the 5-entry table 0xC06B8[x-1][0..4] with the same keep logic, then any): tokens move one at a time (f57CE8/f57E28 with +0x98/+0x99 of both), 0x2EE6C after each area. Re-enables [0xF8E78] (f3C8C4).
0x2c298.globals: 0xF40F0 player count; AI tables int32 0xC0618[10][4] (G: preferred city sites per nation) and 0xC06B8[9][5] (G: token areas), Iberia's rows written here; candidate list 0xF7CA0/0xF7C9C (entries removed); areas +0x0E+x; nations +0x98/+0x99; dialog [0xF8E78]
0x2c298.risks: Self-modifying data: Iberia's rows of two initialised AI tables are rewritten at run time and are not saved, so other readers (0x2C894, 0x2E1D0, 0x2D1C0) see the defaults until this routine has run once. The retry pass skips candidate 0 (idx reset to 0 then incremented, D). The table test reads with x (== src in every call). Tokens counted from x's column, moved from src's.

0x2c778.purpose: Computer's choice of Civil War faction for nation n (eax): for f = 12, 13: score = sum over the faction's cities (list +0x52.., count +0x51; entries are territory+1) of 10 if the AI value byte 0xEED84[160n + t] > 0 else 5, plus over its token areas (list +0x61.., count +0x60) 2 if that value > 0 else 1. Returns 12 + (score12 < score13): 13 only if the second faction scores strictly more.
0x2c778.globals: reads nations 12/13 +0x51, +0x52.., +0x60, +0x61..; AI table int8 0xEED84[n][160] (read as dword [0xEED80 + 160n + (t+1)] sar 24)
0x2c778.risks: The table read uses base 0xEED80 + (t+1); the real table starts at 0xEED84 (other code uses [0xEED84 + ...]), and stack.c treats dword [0xEED80] as a heap pointer freed by NEW GAME/RESTORE: the same address, so check the 0xEED80/0xEED84 layout before porting. Leaf prologue (push before __CHK).

0x2c894.category: calamity AI (losses for a faction or nation)
0x2c894.purpose: Computer removes losses (here Military losses of faction 12/13). f2C894(n = eax, count = edx, text = ebx (caller's 0xA0 buffer), ov = ecx, [flag], [mode]) (ret 8). Screen 3, 'LEFT TO' / 'REMOVE', f3AB7C(text), panel drawn, [0xF8E78] disabled, candidates 0x28CFC(n, mode, 0). left = count; boxes drawn (the number is itoa'd into the caller's text buffer); f3D52C(0,0); wait 500 ms (unattended and [0xF40BA] == 0) or 1500. cityExact = (|ov| + left == 5). Pass 1 over candidates while left > ov: a city of n with cityExact: 'core' flag set at the first table entry 0xC0618[n][k] that differs from t; if core == (flag != 0): city removed (0x78F04), left -= 5. Else tokens of n (not cityExact): 'core' = t in 0xC06B8[n-1][0..4]; if core == (flag != 0): tokens removed one by one (f57CE8 only) while left > ov. After each removal: name/count boxes, highlight, centre, wait 500/1500. Pass 2 (if left > ov): any city (cityExact) or tokens, same display. Re-enables [0xF8E78].
0x2c894.globals: candidate list 0xF7CA0/0xF7C9C; areas +0x0E+n and record +0 (index for the name 0xC77D4); 0xE2C18; AI tables 0xC0618, 0xC06B8; [0xF40BA]; dialog [0xF8E78]
0x2c894.calls: f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, fg_vbopen/vbclose, fg_setcolor, f3A3A0, f3A044, f3AB7C, f7876C, f3B05C, f3C940, 0x28CFC, f3C9D0, itoa, f3A0B0, f3F670, f3D52C, f3CBBC, f7BA64, f78A20, 0x78F04, f57CE8, f3F624, f3DA60, f3C8C4
0x2c894.waits_for_input: no; timed waits 500 or 1500 ms per removal
0x2c894.risks: Called with n = 12/13: 0xC0618 + 16n reads 0xC06D8/0xC06E8 (inside the 0xC06B8 table, Iberia/Illyria rows) and 0xC06B8 + 20(n-1) reads 0xC0794/0xC07A8 (the nation-choice list records): out-of-range table reads (D) that must be kept byte-exact. The city 'core' test is inverted (set when t differs from any entry, so practically always 1, D). Tokens are removed with f57CE8 without decrementing the faction's +0x98 or raising +0x99 (D): later tests in 0x29E34 ('no longer exists', absorb sizes) and the token count given to 0x2D1C0 then disagree with the board (G: possible endless loop in 0x2D1C0). itoa writes into the caller's message buffer.

0x2d10c.purpose: Computer beneficiary annexes k cities of faction o. f2D10C(victim = eax, k = edx, o = ebx, B = ecx). While k != 0: r = 0x20C70(B, o) (G: territory+1 of the best city), t = r-1; area record r +0x3B+victim = 1; 0x78F04(t, o), 0x78E74(t, B); k--; '%s annexes the city in %s' (B, territory) shown 1500 ms with 0x79270(1500, B, t, text, 1).
0x2d10c.risks: No check that 0x20C70 found a city (r = 0 would write area record 0 and remove city -1; G). 0x78-byte stack buffer.

0x2d1c0.purpose: Computer beneficiary annexes k tokens of faction o. f2D1C0(victim = eax, k = edx, o = ebx, B = ecx). Copies o's area list (+0x61.., count +0x60, values territory+1) into a local int array. Pass flag 1, then 0, repeated while k != 0: for each listed r: match = r equals one of 0xC06B8[victim-1][0..4]; if match == flag: for each of o's tokens there while k > 0: area r +0x3B+victim = 1, f57CE8(t, o, 0, 1), o +0x98-- +0x99++, f57E28(t, B, 1), B +0x98++ +0x99--, k--; then '%s annexes tokens in %s' (B, t) 1500 ms.
0x2d1c0.globals: nation o +0x60/+0x61..; areas +0x0E+o, +0x3B+victim; AI table 0xC06B8; nations +0x98/+0x99
0x2d1c0.risks: Compares territory+1 with the 0xC06B8 entries, which other routines compare with territory numbers (D; off by one, G which is meant). The outer loop repeats pass 0 forever while k > 0 and o has no tokens left: it relies on o.+0x98 > k having been tested by the caller; o.+0x98 can be stale after 0x2C894 (G: hang). 0x310-byte stack frame with a 192-entry int array.

0x2d3e0.category: calamity UI (Civil War side choice, human)
0x2d3e0.purpose: Human victim chooses which Civil War faction to play. f2D3E0(n = eax). Clears 0xF547C[14] and 0xF548C[14], then 0xF5488 = nation 12 tokens (+0x98, 0xF1EB8), 0xF5498 = nation 12 cities (0xF1E71), 0xF5489 / 0xF5499 = nation 13's. Screen 3, appends dialog 0xC0214 ('PLAY FIRST FACTION' id 0xB2, 'PLAY SECOND FACTION' id 0xB3), draws the panel, home view f3D9FC(n), f3CBBC, '%s, Choose side to play.' -> r = 0x5CDE8(0, text); removes 0xC0214; returns r (G: 12 or 13).
0x2d3e0.globals: writes int8 0xF547C[14], 0xF548C[14] (tokens/cities per nation for the display, index 12/13 set); reads nations 12/13; byte [0xEE168] = 3; dialog 0xC0214
0x2d3e0.calls: f3CD6C, fg_vbcopy, f7853C, f3B05C, f3D9FC, f3CBBC, sprintf, 0x5CDE8, f78664
0x2d3e0.waits_for_input: inside 0x5CDE8 (unported; G: a click wait on the two buttons)
0x2d3e0.risks: Return value comes straight from 0x5CDE8 (the dispatcher codes for ids 0xB2/0xB3 must map to 12/13, G). 0xF547C is shared with the secondary-loss screens.

0x2d4f0.purpose: Resolves Flood for record i (eax). Clears 0xF547C/0xF548C, int16 [0xBB400] = 0x15, victim n = byte 0xF77E6+3i, exempt e = byte 0xF77E5+3i, [0xF40F8] = n. For the 5 flood plains (table 0xBEE08, 22-byte records {int16 sum, int16 count, char *river, int16 terr[7]}: RHONE, PO, DANUBE, TIGRUS-EUPHRATES, NILE) sum = n's units there (a city of n on a territory with terr byte +1 bit 0x80 counts 5, else tokens). No units on any plain: n's coastal cities (terr byte +0 bit 0x02) into 0xF7CA0; none -> '%s has no units on any flood plain or coastal cities, so is unaffected by Flood.'; else '%s has no units on any flood plain so a coastal city must be %s.' ('reduced' with Engineering +0x2A, else 'eliminated'); human picks with 0x207B4(n, n, 0x19), computer 0x2E1D0(n, 0x19); Engineering -> 0x78FEC(t, n) (reduce) else 0x78F04 (eliminate); human: redraw, 2000 ms; computer: '%s %s a coastal city in %s.' Otherwise the plain with the largest sum (last of equals); on a tie the human picks from the tied list with 0x1EAEC(n, 0x19), the computer with 0x2E45C(n). Losses min(sum, Engineering ? 7 : 17): human 'The %s river Floods.\n%s, choose sites of losses.' NationLosesUnits(n, l, text, 0x19, [plain, 0]); computer 0x260C4(n, l, 0x19, plain). Secondary: for m 1..10 in play except n: units on that plain -> int16 0xF796C[m] = min(units, 10, Engineering ? 7). Total over 1..9: 0 -> nothing; <= 10 -> 'The %s river flooding eliminates all secondary units on the flood plain.' and each m (except e) loses 0xF796C[m] (human with 'Flood also ravages %s.\nChoose sites of losses.' when only part, else 0x260C4); > 10 -> the victim assigns 10 (human 0x29550 or, with one nation, directly; computer 0x27518(n, -1, 10, 0x19)) and each m with 0xF547C[m] > 0 loses that. Pirates (nation 10): 0x260C4(10, raw units, 0x19, plain). End 0x1E69C(i).
0x2d4f0.globals: calamity list 0xF77E4+3i; flood plains 0xBEE08 (int16 sums written); terrflag records 0xE1638 + 35t (+0 bit 0x02 coastal, +1 bit 0x80 flood-plain city G); city state 0xE2C18; areas +0x0E+m; nations +0x2A Engineering, +0x9A; int16 0xF796C[1..10]; int8 0xF547C, 0xF548C; candidate list 0xF7CA0/0xF7C9C; flags 0xE1624 & 0x80; toggles 0xF0980 & 4; int16 [0xF40BA]

0x2d4f0.risks: BUG(1995) candidate (D): in the 'more than 10' branch the per-nation human test reads the victim's record ([ebp-0x1c] +0x9A, 0x2E128) instead of nation m's, so computer secondary victims of a human victim get the human loss screen and human ones of a computer victim are chosen automatically (the <= 10 branch tests m correctly). The tie branch for computers leaves the chosen plain uninitialised if fewer than 2 entries (not reachable when ties > 0, G). Pirates' losses use the uncapped local count. River pointer read from the initialised table (relocated pointer). 0xF796C written for m = 10 (int16 0xF7980).

0x2e1d0.purpose: Computer picks one of its cities from the list 0xF7CA0 (count 0xF7C9C) for calamity card c (edx), nation n (eax). threat[j] = n's tokens in the land neighbours ([0xF8E7C + 4t], k = 1..count) of list[j]; best = first index of the strict maximum. c == 0x19 (Flood): for city index i from cities-1 down to 0 and every j: if city +0x52+i == list[j]+1 and (list[j] not in 0xC0618[n][0..3] or j == best) return list[j]; fallback returns list[stale j] if it matches a city. c == 0x1E (Piracy): the first city in city-list order that is in the list. Otherwise list[0].
0x2e1d0.globals: list 0xF7CA0/0xF7C9C; adjacency [0xF8E7C+4t]; areas +0x0E+n; nation +0x51, +0x52.. (territory+1); AI table 0xC0618
0x2e1d0.risks: Local threat array has 9 ints: a list longer than 9 overwrites the frame (cities, so at most 9). best is uninitialised when no candidate has a threat > 0 (D). The Flood fallback uses the loop index left at count (reads list[count], one past the end, D). Leaf prologue.

0x2e45c.purpose: Computer victim chooses among tied flood plains (indices in 0xF7CA0). Writes int32 [0xBEDE8] = ([0xF40F0] == 3) (Iberia's entry of the 'own river' table 0xBEDE0: Rhone normally, Po in 3-player games). Clears highlights, takes the first listed plain that is not avoid[n] (0xBEDE0[n]: Africa -1, Iberia 0/1, Illyria 2, Thrace 2, Crete -1, Asia -1, Assyria 3, Babylon 3, Egypt 4), shows '%s choses the %s to flood.' with every territory of that plain highlighted (0x79270(-500, n, -200, text, 0)) and returns it.
0x2e45c.globals: writes int32 0xBEDE8; reads 0xBEDE0[n]; plains 0xBEE08 (count, river name, territories); list 0xF7CA0/0xF7C9C
0x2e45c.risks: Self-modifying data (0xBEDE8, not saved). If every listed plain were avoided it returns list[count] (one past the end); not reachable with >= 2 distinct plains. Text slip 'choses'.

0x2e59c.purpose: Resolves Epidemic for record i (eax). Message area (0xA9, 0x154, 0x12C, 0x15). Victim n, exempt e (byte 0xF77E5+3i), [0xF40F8] = n. Losses 16, -8 with Medicine (+0x2D), +5 with Roadbuilding (+0x28), capped at eligible = tokens on board - token areas (+0x98 - +0x60) + 4*cities. Human: 'Epidemic ravages %s.\nChoose sites of losses.', x = (tokens - areas == 0) ? 0x2EC38(n, losses) : 0, NationLosesUnits(n, losses, text, 0x1B, [0, x]); computer 0x260C4(n, losses, 0x1B, -1). Secondary: int16 0xF796C[m] = min(eligible(m), 10) for m 1..9 in play except n and e. Total <= 25: 0xF547C[m] = 0xF796C[m] and 0x291D0(n, -1, 'Assignments for Epidemic secondary losses.' (human path) or '... losses' without the period (computer path)). Total > 25: human '%s, assign secondary losses for Epidemic.' 0x29550(n, e, 25, text); computer 0x27518(n, e, 25, 0x1B). Then for m 1..9 with 0xF547C[m] != 0: Medicine -5 (floor 0), Roadbuilding +5, cap eligible; > 0: human m 'Epidemic also ravages %s.\nChoose sites of losses.' NationLosesUnits (with 0x2EC38 when only cities), computer 0x260C4; reduced to 0 -> '%s saved from Epidemic by MEDICINE.' End: 0x1E69C(i), int16 [0xBB400] = 0x23.
0x2e59c.globals: message area 0xBB3FA..0xBB400 (written); calamity list; nations +0x28, +0x2D, +0x51, +0x60, +0x98, +0x9A; int16 0xF796C; int8 0xF547C
0x2e59c.waits_for_input: Indirect: NationLosesUnits, 0x29550, 0x291D0 (CONTINUE), 0x79270(-500) for the MEDICINE message
0x2e59c.risks: Byte arithmetic on 0xF547C (sub 5 then signed test). The 'saved by MEDICINE' message passes the victim n as the panel nation, not m. Two near-identical strings (period). Roadbuilding raises a secondary victim's loss after the assignment.

0x2ec38.purpose: For Epidemic when nation n (eax) has no spare tokens: computes the remainder argument for NationLosesUnits from losses L (edx). v_i = 5 - 0x78D08(city_i (territory+1 from +0x52+i), n) for each city, sorted ascending (bubble sort). a = b = L; for each city i: if a - v_i >= 0 and a >= 4 and b - v_i >= 0 and b >= 4: return 0 when a == 4 or b == 4, else a -= v_i, b -= 4; otherwise return 0 when the a-branch fits but a < 4 (and similar for b), else return max(a - v_i, b - v_i). After all cities: 0.
0x2ec38.risks: Nested compare chain with four exits; local array of 9 ints (cities <= 9). Must be translated branch for branch.

0x2ee6c.purpose: Shows one automatic step: f2EE6C(n = eax, t = edx (-1 = none), left = ebx). In the back buffer: sunken box (0x109,0x186,0x6E,0x13) with territory name 0xC77D8[t] (if t >= 0), box (0x136,0x172,0x13,0x13) with 'left' centred (w 0x14); panel drawn (f3B05C(0xF596C)), f459E4(n), highlights cleared, t highlighted colour 15 and centred (f3DA60), else home view f3D9FC(n) for n <= 9 or f3D52C(0,0) for factions; f3CBBC; 1500 ms wait.
0x2ee6c.calls: fg_vbopen/vbclose, f3C9D0, fg_setcolor, f3A0B0, itoa, f3B05C, f459E4, f3F670, f3F624, f3DA60, f3D9FC, f3D52C, f3CBBC, f78A20(1500)
0x2ee6c.risks: f459E4 is called with faction nations 12/13 (status panel of a non-player).

0x32214.purpose: The City Construction phase. Builds the turn list int16 0xF06B0[] (count [0xF06AE]) of nations in play, labels the player buttons (f783B8(0xF596C, [0xF5940])). need_screen = 1 unless PBEM and nobody has Architecture (+0x31); special = area record 114 (territory 113) has exactly one nation k+1 with >= 6 tokens and Agriculture (+0x27) (G). For n 1..9 in play with < 9 cities: [0xF40F8] = n, arch = +0x31, candidates 0x334F4(arch, n) (territories 0xF7CA0, tokens needed int32 0xF7F20). Human (+0x9A == 3): if neither flag, every candidate is built at once ('%s builds a city in %s', 2000 ms or -500 with toggle 0xF0980 & 1); else the screen: dialog 0xC154C (site arrows 0x39/0x3A, treasury arrows 0x3B/0x3C enabled only with Architecture, BUILD CITY 0x3D, FINISHED 0x2A), 'CANDIDATE SITES FOR CITIES', 'TREASURY'/'CONTRIBUTION' (grey 0x17 when disabled). With Architecture: max = min(terr +1 bit 0x40 ? 3 : 6, treasury +0x3E), min = need - tokens (>= 0). Codes: map click -> site, -9/-10 site, -11/-12 contribution within min..max, -13 build (city state owner/round [0xF40FC], city list, treasury -= c, tokens -= need - c, stock += need, board -= need - c, f581C4, list rebuilt; a non-zero contribution uses up Architecture), -1 finished. Computer (+0x9A == 2): screen 3, start time clock(); if cities + candidates > 9: (with Architecture) candidates reordered: enough tokens; short with state bit 0x02; short and int16 0xF3580[n-1][t] bit 0x80 clear; the rest; then stable ascending sort by need. Builds every site with enough tokens (300 ms highlight each, 0x333E8), then with Architecture one more site (area with only n, tokens + treasury >= need, cities < half the tokens on board) paying from the treasury ('using Architecture'). Then waits until 2000 ms after the start (or 500/1000 unattended), unless toggle 0xF0980 & 1. If no nation had candidates: 0x79270(100, first nation, -200, '', 0).
0x32214.globals: int16 0xF06AE / 0xF06B0[] (turn order, written); word [0xF408E] = 1 (G: PBEM interaction flag); area record 114 (0xE5072..); city state 0xE2C18 (+0 owner, +1 round [0xF40FC], +2 bit 0); nations +0x27 +0x31 +0x3E +0x51 +0x52.. +0x98 +0x99 +0x9A; candidates int32 0xF7CA0/0xF7F20, count [0xF7C9C]; int16 0xF3580[9][157] (AI flags, bit 0x80); terrflag +1 bit 0x40; dialog 0xC154C; panel 0xF596C; [0xF5940]; PBEM player byte 0xE1622; toggles 0xF0980
