0x7ae14.risks: Separate copy of the text (0xB96F6) with the 'to often' slip.

0x7af28.purpose: Peek of the World State Stack: copies the top slot (depth [0xCAC54]) back into the areas, territory state and nations without popping.
0x7af28.globals: reads [0xCAC54], [0xF5240 + 4d], [0xF5268 + 4d], [0xF5290 + 4d]; writes World State blocks: areas 1..160 at 0xE31FD (0x2B20 bytes), territory state 0xE2C18 (0x1E0), nations 1..11 at 0xF1593 (0x88D)
0x7af28.risks: No check for an empty stack: depth -1 reads the pointer fields at 0xF523C/0xF5264/0xF528C (D). Heap pointers (port handles, stack.c).

0x7afb8.purpose: Peek of the Move List Stack: copies slot [0xCAC58]'s lists and counts back without popping.
0x7afb8.globals: reads [0xCAC58], slot arrays; writes the move lists and counts

0x7b044.purpose: Scores nation n's position for the AI (returns int, capped at 0x7FFF, no lower bound). Over n's areas (+0x60 count, +0x61.. area ids): L = population limit (bits 3..5 of the territory's byte +1), +1 with advance 3 (+0x27) when n is alone; a value byte [0xEED83 + 160n + a] plus bit 6 of territory byte +1 adds v/4 when non-zero; overpopulation (n alone, tokens +0xE+n > L) adds T - L to a penalty; territory flag bit 0x01 of byte +2 counts; state +2 bit 0x02 (G: not the city bit, which is 0x01) counts and adds byte [0xEFA03 + 160n + a]. For entries of the move list 0x107694 with byte0 == 0xC9 (G: an attack on nation m = byte1): c = 50 (200 if m is human) + int32 [0xF52E0 + 40n + 4m] (score difference, 0x7C960), times int32 0xC2864[3*idx + level] / 100 (idx = byte 0xBCCE0 + 85(m-1) + 5*AST(n) (+1 if m is human), level = bits 10..11 of word [0xE1624]), clamped at 0, summed. Result: 500*cities (+0x51) + 500*bit-0x02 areas + 100*their values + 300*areas + values - 200*overpopulation - 200*flag-1 territories + attacks; with byte [0xF488C + n] or dword [0x108164 + 4n] set the area and value terms are divided by 4 and overpopulation costs 300.
0x7b044.globals: reads nation n (+0x27, +0x51, +0x5C, +0x60, +0x61..), territory records +1/+2 (0xE1639), area records (+1, +2.., +0xE+n), state 0xE2C18 + 3t, 0xEED83.., 0xEFA03.., move list 0x107694 / [0x1079B4], 0xF52E0, 0xBCCE0, 0xC2864, word [0xE1624], 0xF488C, 0x108164
0x7b044.risks: Dead local: the room-to-grow sum [ebp-0x38] is computed and never used (D). Index into 0xC2864 assumes idx 0..5 and level 0..2 (level 3 would read the next row). Signed divisions (sbb/sar idiom for /4).

0x7bd5c.purpose: The AI's per-territory analysis for nation n: memset(0xF3580 + 314(n-1), 0, 314) (int16 flags for territories 1..157), then for each territory t: occupied areas (area +1 != 0) and empty ones get different checks over the land neighbours (lists 0xF8E7C[t]) and, with byte +0x28 of n (G: an advance), the territories reachable by sea from f4892C (two 160-int stack arrays handed to it). Flags set (bit -> meaning G): 0x01 empty neighbours / only n, 0x02, 0x04 enemy stronger (compares the strongest other nation's tokens +0xF+m with the population limit + 1 + (n's +0x26 - m's +0x26), G: Metalworking), 0x08, 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80, 0x100, 0x200, 0x400, 0x800; uses f7C760 (first nation present) and f7C7C4 (first other nation present).
0x7bd5c.globals: writes int16 0xF3580 + 314(n-1) + 2t (flags); reads area records, territory records (+1, bits 3..5), state 0xE2C18 (city, owner), land lists 0xF8E7C[], nations +0x26, +0x28
0x7bd5c.calls: f4892C x2, f7C760, f7C7C4 x3, memset
0x7bd5c.risks: 2564 bytes, 0x570-byte frame with two int[160] stack arrays passed to f4892C. A compare whose result is thrown away at 0x7C71E (city owner == n, no branch; D). Many flag bits whose meaning needs the AI readers. Loop 1..157 (0x9D, the territories with the three aliases left out, G).

0x7c760.purpose: Returns the first nation m (1..11) present in territory t (eax): area record t+1 byte +1+m == m; 0 if none.

0x7c7c4.purpose: Returns the first nation m (1..11) other than n (edx) present in territory t (eax); 0 if none.
0x7c7c4.callers: 16 call sites in 10 functions: f3433C, f3580C, f37CF8 x2, f396FC x2, f39C08, f48028 x2, f4876C, f4892C x2, f4BBDC, f7BD5C x3

0x7c838.purpose: What-if conflict: copies area record t+1 (69 bytes) to a local and the nations to 0x116FFC (f7A778); adds k (ebx) tokens of n (edx) (area +0xE+n), marks n present (+1+n = n, count +1 + 1) if it was not; memset(0xF547C, 0, 10); byte [0xBB3F8] = 0 (G: no display); f5B588(t+1) resolves the conflict; [0xBB3F8] = 1; *ecx = the number of nations left in the area; nations and the area record restored. Returns byte [0xF547C + n] (G: n's losses or survivors).
0x7c838.globals: reads/writes area record t+1 (restored), nations (restored via 0x116FFC), 0xF547C[10], byte [0xBB3F8]
0x7c838.risks: If f5B588 draws game_rand the trial consumes random numbers (G: check f5B588). Restores [0xBB3F8] to 1 regardless of its earlier value. ecx is a caller's pointer (stack local, G).

0x7c960.purpose: Builds the AI's score-difference matrix: memset(0xF52E0, 0, 400) (int32[10][10]); for each nation i 1..9 in play: s_i = f147C4(i) (the score), leader [0xF52D4] = the i with the highest score (start -9999); for each j in play int32 [0xF52E0 + 40i + 4j] = s_j - s_i. Also tracks the maximum of byte 0xBCCE0 + 85(i-1) + 5*AST(i), never used.
0x7c960.risks: Dead local [ebp-0x14] (the 0xBCCE0 maximum, D). f147C4 is called 1 + (players) times per nation.

0x7cab4.purpose: Returns 1 if every entry int32 [0xF52E0 + 40n + 4j], j 1..9, is >= 0 (no nation scores below n: n is last or tied), else 0.
0x7cab4.risks: Entries of nations not in play are 0 and pass.
